No existing harness entry covers this project, both facts are durable, host-neutral project facts with direct user evidence, and the estimation decision is a dated status change that warrants its own entry per the update policy.

edits.title: Research project: MATLAB model of temporary employment, firm heterogeneity and regulation (working code as of Nov 2023)
edits.content: The user is developing a MATLAB labor-economics model of temporary employment, firm heterogeneity and regulation (the working program is headed 'Temporary Employment, Firm Heterogeneity and Regulation'; discussed 2023-11-08). Model structure from the user's own code: heterogeneous firm productivity y; permanent-job cutoff lambdap computed analytically as (y - r*U - r*cc)/(cc + fc); temporary-job cutoff lambdat solved numerically with csolve on eval_lambdat(lambda, cc, U, fc, r, y); the full program also solves a conversion cutoff lambdas with fzero. Stocks: stockP is the integral of (1/lambda) weighted by G(lambdap, dscale, dshape) - G(1e-8, dscale, dshape) over [1e-8, lambdap]; stockT is the integral of (1/lambda)*log(y/(r*U)) weighted by G(lambdat, dscale, dshape) - G(lambdap, dscale, dshape) over [lambdap, lambdat]. Parameters: dscale and dshape (parameters of the shock-arrival-rate distribution G), fc and cc (labeled in the code as firing costs and cost of writing a contract), r (interest rate, converted from annual to daily), U (unemployment value normalized to 1/r).
edits.reason: Durable context for the user's economics research project so future assistance with this model (thresholds, stocks, parameters) does not require re-deriving its structure from scratch.

edits.title: Temporary employment model: estimating dscale, dshape, fc, cc by GMM from observed y, stockP, stockT data instead of pre-decided values (decided 2023-11-08)
edits.content: Status change on 2023-11-08: the user had been working with pre-decided values for the parameters dshape, dscale, fc and cc in their temporary-employment MATLAB model, and now wants to estimate these four parameters using GMM to match values observed in the data. Observed data: for each productivity value y, the user observes a stockP value and a stockT value. Adopted data pipeline: read a CSV file with readmatrix with three columns - y (column 1), stockP (column 2), stockT (column 3) - replacing the earlier approach of a simulated random sample of y with fixed parameters. Estimation targets: dscale, dshape, fc, cc. This entry records the plan as of 2023-11-08; any later change (different estimator, data, or estimated values) should be recorded as a separate new entry.
edits.reason: Records the dated methodological shift from fixed parameters to GMM estimation with observed (y, stockP, stockT) data, the current goal of the project, so later sessions resume from the estimation setup rather than the calibration setup.

proposal.expectedOutcome: Future turns or sessions on this project can recall the model's cutoffs, stocks, and parameters and that the active task is GMM estimation of dscale, dshape, fc, cc from CSV-observed (y, stockP, stockT) data, so MATLAB assistance resumes from the estimation context without re-deriving the model; validate by confirming later code help builds on the GMM setup.
